rationale: COO gapped down 18% on 6x relative volume and has rebounded to the top of its range, but the last five 5-minute candles show a very tight, low-volume consolidation with ATR at just $0.10 and a spread that is wide relative to that ATR. The bullish momentum above the 5-minute VWAP and 9-EMA is balanced by the risk of a failed breakout at the day’s high, and the inconsistent session VWAP data adds uncertainty. With a limited daily loss budget remaining, the edge is insufficient to justify a directional trade.
